model.name: Classic-v1 champion (v2 artifact)
model.pointsModel: stable season prior plus configured CatBoost fixture residual
model.quantiles: heuristic unconditional UI intervals; not calibrated decision intervals
model.reserveModel: position-specific 1-product(1-pDNP) under conditional independence; best-response roster selection and exact candidate rescoring
model.objective: fixed-v1 champion retained after the challenger regressed in validation
model.starterEligibility: all selectable players; availability is priced into expected points
model.historicalMarketSnapshots: unavailable; validation is experimental until archived snapshots exist

validation.protocol: rolling-origin preseason selection followed by actual-cutoff state replay and legal winter reoptimization; baseline receives the same winter action space and exact reserve scoring
validation.historicalMarketSnapshots: unavailable: completed-season metadata is not proven to be a decision-time snapshot, so these results must not be described as leakage-safe

0001.fallbackReason: recourse challenger did not win the rolling-origin baseline ladder

0003.fallbackReason: recourse challenger did not win the rolling-origin baseline ladder
